summary: Computes and visualizes trial-averaged PSTHs for PMd neurons categorized by decision choice and coherence difficulty during the perceptual decision-formation period.
use_when: How do I analyze heterogeneous PMd neuronal responses during decision making?
Compute stimulus-aligned PSTHs for macaque PMd neurons by choice and difficulty
Generate sliding window firing rate plots for PMd units from stimulus to RT
How to challenge canonical ramping models with single-neuron firing patterns?
Analyze trial-averaged firing rates in PMd with 75ms bins and SEM
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
